'''Fardan Dei''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], he [[Sith training|trained]] under his father, the [[Sith Saber]] [[Querdan Dei]] and was onboard the same [[Starship/Legends|starship]] as him.
